policies.title: Georgian ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule lists Georgia as requiring no visitor visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Georgian passport holder travelling to Grenada as a short visitor.
The Embassy's live visitor page confirms requirements depend on citizenship; work, study, residence, diplomatic, official, service and special-document treatment remain outside scope.
Admission remains subject to Grenada immigration control, carrier checks and final entry conditions.

policies.title: Georgian ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule names Georgia in the authorized-visa cohort, requiring advance consular processing unless a separate third-country-document waiver applies.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Georgian passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate valid third-country visa or residence waiver.
The Embassy requires an authorized-visa applicant to appear in person at the consulate before travel; approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, special documents, consular-jurisdiction requirements and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on document verification and completion.
steps: Determine that Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Appear in person and submit the listed authorized-visa documents to the competent Panamanian consulate before travel.
Do not finalize travel arrangements until the visa has been granted.

policies.title: Georgian ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board nationality table expressly identifies Georgia as eligible to obtain a visitor visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Georgian passport holder travelling to Jordan as a short visitor.
The official table says the visa can be obtained upon arrival and states a 40 JOD total charge.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier checks, border-crossing limits and final admission remain outside scope.
